verdict.rationale: Muse operates via its own cloud VM with file system/terminal, writing code and custom connectors to interact with linked services (email, calendar, Instagram, etc.) rather than directly controlling apps on the user's own device — this is closer to an agentic sandbox with API-based connectors than true desktop/app control. Community evidence also shows the control-plane can time out under load, hinting at real-world limits to this operation model. Missing for 10: evidence of direct GUI/desktop app control on the user's own machine, first-party demonstration of operating third-party apps beyond API/CLI connectors, and independent confirmation the VM-based approach reliably substitutes for local app operation.
